main.description: Ban an account from a community, with that community's authority. The caller must be a moderator of the community, which this instance must host, or an instance admin; an admin's ban is recorded as an admin acting for the community. The account must hold no role in the community: remove its role first. The instance writes the social.coves.moderation.ban record at the account's derived key in the community's repo (rewriting a standing ban), and applies it to its index before responding. The actor is the authenticated account, never a request field. Bans are rate limited per moderator and per community; instance admins are exempt.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: Authentication is required; sign in before retrying.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller is neither a moderator of the community nor an instance admin, or the community is not hosted here or is removed; do not retry.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The request is incomplete or malformed: community or subject is not a DID, subject is the community, reason is too long, expiresAt is not in the future, expectedVersion is negative or idempotencyKey is empty or too long; correct it before retrying.

errors.name: SubjectHoldsRole
errors.description: The account holds a role in the community; remove the role before banning it.

errors.name: StateConflict
errors.description: expectedVersion is not the account's current community version, the indexed ban is behind the community's repo, or a write affecting the account in the community has an unknown outcome; refetch getCommunityState for the account before retrying.

errors.name: IdempotencyConflict
errors.description: The same key was reused with a different request; do not retry with that key.

errors.name: RateLimitExceeded
errors.description: The caller or the community has banned too many accounts in the last hour; retry later.

errors.name: ModerationUnavailable
errors.description: The moderation service or the community's repo is temporarily unavailable; retry later with the same idempotency key.

input.description: Request to ban an account from a community

subject.description: DID of the account to ban

reason.description: Human-readable reason for the ban, written to the ban record and shown to the banned account

expiresAt.description: When the ban ends, in the future; whole seconds are kept. Omitted for a permanent ban.

expectedVersion.description: The account's community version (getCommunityState with the account DID as subject) the caller expects

idempotencyKey.description: Opaque key that makes a retry of the same request return its first result; scoped to the caller and the community

output.description: The account's community ban state after the action, applied before the response returns

uri.description: AT-URI of the account's ban record in the community's repo (written by banAccount, deleted by unbanAccount)

version.description: The account's community version after the action

actionId.description: ID of the moderation action logged for the change; absent when the decision was already in place

alreadyApplied.description: True when the decision was already in place, so nothing was written and no action was logged
